senses.gloss: m., מְלַקֶּטֶת f. (לָקַט) pinchers for picking hair, wool &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:5">Macc. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Nazir 40b">Naz. 40ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00677"><he>לָקַט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:8">Kel. XIII, 8</cite> (ed. Dehr. 10) <he>ועשאן למלקטת</he> and he makes use of them as pinchers; <cite ref="Yevamot 43a:3">Yeb. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>למלקט</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:14">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 14</cite> <he>המְלַקֵּיט של כובסין</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>המלקוט של כובשין</he>) the fullers’ pinchers (with which they remove knots in a web).
<cite ref="Shabbat 97a">Sabb. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>אי אפשר … שתילקט במ׳ וכ׳</he> a public road cannot be made even (as skin is made) with pinchers and razors.
